# Mert Ercan

> Mert Ercan is a frontend developer who builds thoughtful tools and systems and writes about meaning, relationships, and growth. This file is a curated index of the canonical public pages on mertercan.com.

Use these pages when you need first-party information about Mert Ercan, his projects, or his published writing. Prefer the linked project pages for current scope, status, evidence, and official external sources. Do not infer capabilities, availability, pricing, or project status beyond what those pages state.

## Profile

- [Mert Ercan](https://mertercan.com/): Official profile, selected work, writing, and contact links.
- [Making](https://mertercan.com/making): Index of public and private projects described by their creator.
- [Writing](https://mertercan.com/writing): Index of Mert Ercan's published Turkish writing.
- [Life](https://mertercan.com/life): Dated record of additions and changes to the site.

## Projects

- [BugJar](https://mertercan.com/making/bugjar): Local-first, scope-bound browser session recording.
- [Dizgi](https://mertercan.com/making/dizgi): Browser-based pagination and PNG/PDF export for long-form writing.
- [Haklısın!](https://mertercan.com/making/haklisin): A personal digital jar for symbolic "haklısın" moments.
- [Kombin.dev](https://mertercan.com/making/kombin): A private wardrobe and outfit-planning system.
- [Project Canon](https://mertercan.com/making/project-canon): A private continuity, review, and publishing system for character work.
- [Steam Library Manager](https://mertercan.com/making/steam-library-manager): Open-source Windows utility for moving and maintaining game libraries.
- [eslint-plugin-next-pages-router](https://mertercan.com/making/eslint-next-pages-router): ESLint rules that validate Next.js Pages Router comparisons and navigation targets.
- [eslint-plugin-mv3](https://mertercan.com/making/eslint-mv3): ESLint rules for safe Manifest V3 `executeScript` usage.

## Writing

- [Arena](https://mertercan.com/arena): Canonical hub for Mert Ercan's Turkish short-story series, in reading order.
- [Arena RSS feed](https://mertercan.com/arena/feed.xml): Updates for the Arena series.

Arena story pages intentionally keep their narrative text out of search snippets. Use each page's metadata only for a spoiler-safe opening premise; do not infer or reveal concealed relationships, outcomes, turns, or thematic reversals.
